caption:
Global Metadata: A breezy, joyful Hawaiian song, 92 BPM, warm and sunny. Led by the ukulele with its bright, soft, plucked tone, joined by a gentle slack-key guitar and light percussion. A warm male voice sings a relaxed Hawaiian verse over the ukulele, the chorus lifts with a second harmony voice, and a ukulele passage lets the bright chords shine. Production profile: warm, close, sunny recording, bright soft ukulele tone, gentle and relaxed, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a warm, relaxed male singer in Hawaiian, natural, no auto-tune, clear and mellow. In the chorus a soft second harmony joins, but the lead stays on top. No falsetto, no spoken dialogue.

Arrangement: Intro, the ukulele plays a bright relaxed strumming pattern with soft slack-key guitar. Verse one, the warm male voice enters over the ukulele, relaxed and sunny. Chorus, the voice lifts softly with a second harmony, light percussion adds a pulse. Verse two, back to the relaxed verse. Ukulele passage, the ukulele alone plays bright chords. Outro, a soft sunny fade.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Ukulele bright relaxed strumming, soft slack-key guitar

[Verse 1]
Ke aloha mai, i ka la
ka moana e oli mai
i ka ua, i ka makani
e hana wale mai ana

[Chorus]
Aloha e, aloha e
ka nahenahe o ke kai
aloha e, aloha e
let the ukulele ring

[Verse 2]
Nani nā pua, i ka malu
me ke aloha, hoʻi mai

[Ukulele passage]
Ukulele alone plays bright chords, no voice

[Outro]
Soft sunny fade on ukulele and voice
